**Daily Devotional**

**July 14**

*23 Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life. (Proverbs 4:23 KJV)*

The word heart in this verse is not talking about the physical pump in our bodies, but rather the innermost part of us, our soul. The bible uses the term heart to refer to the soul of us humans, which includes our emotions and mind, or what many people refer to as our personality. All humans have a soul, which is the spiritual part of them, as our soul is a spiritual being. That is why our soul will never die, as it is a spirit.

When God made man He breathed the breath of life into Adam (Genesis 2:7), and he became a living soul, and had the spirit of God living in him. When Adam sinned, his spirit died. All born again humans consist of a spirit (Galatians 4:6), soul and body (1 Thessalonians 5:23). The born again man has a new spirit (2 Corinthians 5:17), which has the mind of Christ (1 Corinthians 2:16), knows all things (1 John 2:20) and is exactly like Christ (1 John 4:17). The Christians spirit is always in faith, so we have to get our souls and bodies into agreement with our spirits to be able to walk in the victorious life that Jesus has purchased for us, and that is only when we believe with all our hearts (Acts 8:37). Praise God for His wonderful plan of salvation for us sinners.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com

Personally, I do what I can by gardening and buying from local farmers directly (never mind the MASSIVE step up in quality/taste).
